title: corydalis bulbosa f. capillaris
intro: Corydalis bulbosa f. capillaris, commonly known as Yellow Corydalis, is a perennial plant species in the Papaveraceae family, native to East Asia and used in traditional medicine for centuries. The plant has been found to possess several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and analgesic properties, which can help alleviate pain, reduce inflammation, and protect against oxidative stress. Therapeutically, Corydalis bulbosa f. capillaris is known to exhibit sedative, muscle relaxant, and anti-anxiety actions, making it a potential treatment for conditions such as insomnia, anxiety disorders, and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, such as tetrahydropalmatine, protopine, and corydaline, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
